_comment: UPDATED 2026-09-24 -- now takes TWO uploads: the samplesheet (sample metadata, changes per dataset) and the params config (pipeline settings, stable across datasets/reused per pipeline version). Still NOT deciding which individual SPATIA parameters (conditions, marker thresholds, triad radius, etc.) should be exposed as separate form fields vs. bundled into config_file -- that remains a UX call for Afrouz (operating rule 1), unchanged from the original draft note.

samplesheet.title: Samplesheet (.csv)
samplesheet.description: sample_id,image_path,group -- one row per sample. Generated from an existing experiment YAML via derive_samplesheet.py, or written by hand for a new dataset.

config_file.title: SPATIA pipeline params (.yaml)
config_file.description: Pipeline parameters only -- thresholds, which steps run, marker panel, etc. No sample paths or metadata (those come from the samplesheet above).
